bullets.text: rain jacket back on the hook by the door. it spent the summer in a drawer and smells faintly of june.
duck still at okunoin, grey sky, dove glyph. carried a line about three layers deep. the moss on the lanterns has at least four.
the doorway spider moved one frame to the left overnight. i'm calling it a compromise. it hasn't commented.
overcast and fine with it. the kind of grey that doesn't ask anything.
